core_result: The expedition returned as reference stock rather than a single shipment plan. American references were selectively and progressively reactivated across the 1893-1894 production queue, while some retained references remained taxonomically unresolved after field capture. Gate B therefore requires stored-stock, taxonomic-status, activation, production and dispatch states.

batch_checkpoints.source: Goodale to Mrs and Miss Ware
batch_checkpoints.evidence: a few of the American plants collected on the journey, and a large group of Cryptogamia
batch_checkpoints.interpretation: early selective activation; expedition material remains a minority qualitative component within a mixed workshop program

batch_checkpoints.evidence: 37 ordinary plant species: 20 Jamaica, 15 West, arithmetic reconstruction 2 garden; second portion higher-science/anatomy/physiology especially Cryptogams
batch_checkpoints.shipment_context: 8th shipment; models 374-410 ordinary block, followed by 411-423 scientific/cryptogamic block
batch_checkpoints.interpretation: expedition reference stock becomes a quantified production block while remaining aggregated with parallel scientific work
batch_checkpoints.guard: Regional model-number subranges are high-confidence inferred blocks rather than printed regional headings.

batch_checkpoints.evidence: January consignment of 50 flower species, with only a few stated exceptions, made from Jamaica and West material/studies; Darlingtonia explicitly said to have been made
batch_checkpoints.interpretation: 1892 stock becomes the principal reference base for a complete major batch
batch_checkpoints.guard: Do not describe all 50 as American; source states exceptions.

new_state.taxonomic_latency: A physical reference can survive field capture while its taxonomic identity remains unresolved or provisional; identification may be completed later in Hosterwitz and/or Cambridge before or during model production.
new_state.evidence: Blaschkas report determining previously undetermined Jamaica plants with scanty means and say some western plants were probably determined in the Harvard institution in the meantime.

latency_types.phenological_latency: desired biological state occurs later and may require seed, bulb, cultivation or deferred supply
latency_types.taxonomic_latency: reference is physically available but identity remains unfinished
latency_types.production_latency: usable reference waits on workshop priority/capacity or competing programs
latency_types.dispatch_latency: finished model waits on mounting, crate manufacture, packing, insurance, certification or transport

article_consequence: Return should be treated as conversion of a moving expedition into an inventory/queue, not as the endpoint of fieldwork followed by immediate manufacture. Fieldwork ended in 1892 while its references remained operational in workshop production across later consignments.
working_sentences: The expedition returned as stock, not as a shipment plan.
Fieldwork ended in 1892; the expedition remained operational in the workshop for years.
Return converted a moving expedition into a reference inventory whose members waited on identification, priority and workshop capacity before reappearing as glass.
